# airflow-provider-openfeature

> Feature flags for Apache Airflow: ramp, A/B test, and kill-switch a DAG's behavior and its task
> placement (pool, queue, executor) through OpenFeature. Works with flagd, LaunchDarkly, GrowthBook,
> Unleash, Statsig, or an in-house engine.

It installs as a standard pip package and plugs into two extension points Airflow and OpenFeature
already expose: an Airflow cluster policy and an OpenFeature provider. It stays off until enabled in
config. The four well-known flag keys the placement policy reads are `airflow.task.pool`,
`airflow.task.queue`, `airflow.task.executor`, and `airflow.task.priority_weight`.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): a 5-minute walkthrough on real Airflow with flagd.
- [Use cases](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/docs/use-cases.md): the standard toggle taxonomy mapped to Airflow, with recipes.
- [Running a rollout](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/docs/running-a-rollout.md): the day-to-day ramp, measure, and revert loop.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): the data flow and the three surfaces it registers (policy, hook/sensor/gate, exposure listener).
- [Measurement](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/docs/measurement.md): record an outcome to your experiment platform or warehouse.
- [Extending](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/docs/extending.md): add a backend adapter.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): dev setup, tests, and conventions.

## Examples

- [Example DAGs](https://github.com/1fanwang/airflow-provider-openfeature/tree/main/example_dags): runnable templates (revenue-rollup canary, 2-to-3 migration, KubernetesExecutor canary, A/B a model).
